title.zh: 水位上升的泳池中游泳

desc.zh: 从路径最高点推导最小瓶颈搜索，逐步证明最早可达水位。
desc.en: Derive a minimum-bottleneck search from path maxima and prove the earliest reachable water level.

complexity: O(n² log n) time; O(n²) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Minimum bottleneck path
concepts.description: Extend a path by max, then settle the smallest discovered bottleneck.
